name: io.github.ouranos-labs/pseolint
title: pseolint
description: Penalty-risk audit for programmatic SEO sites: verdict, risk score, and a fix manifest.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AI provider key used ONLY by the pseolint_orchestrate_audit tool (auto-detects ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / etc.). The other three tools run without it.

environmentVariables.name: PSEOLINT_MCP_SAMPLE_CAP
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Max pages sampled per audit (default 50).
